guideSource: User supplied 14 labels and described guide silhouettes; screenshot bitmap is not embedded in this worker context. No third-party sprite is used.

styles.name: ผมสั้นธรรมดา
styles.silhouette: Compact rounded short crop, soft uneven fringe, short clean nape, no high spikes or tail.
styles.asymmetry: Existing slightly swept fringe reverses chirality in the west mirror; not independently painted.

styles.name: ผมสั้นซอย
styles.silhouette: Distinct close tapered temples and nape, small separated feathered upper locks, low textured crown, no rounded helmet and no tail.
styles.asymmetry: Small irregular locks are mirrored, not a claim of separately painted strands.

styles.name: แสกกลาง
styles.silhouette: Visible center part at crown, two balanced curtain fringe wings framing forehead above protected eyes, ear-length sides, softly tapered nape. No one-sided sweep.
styles.asymmetry: Center part is bilaterally balanced; strand lighting is mirrored in west.

styles.name: ปัดข้าง
styles.silhouette: Strong left-rooted side part with a single broad fringe swept to character right, one exposed temple and one longer fringe wing, cropped nape.
styles.asymmetry: One-sided part must retain anatomical handedness; an east mirror is not an independently correct opposite profile.

styles.name: รองทรง
styles.silhouette: Close dark-shaded cropped temples and nape under a wider dense upper shelf, clear stepped transition, moderate height, no towering spikes.
styles.asymmetry: Balanced undercut; west lighting and small strands mirrored.

styles.name: สั้นตั้ง
styles.silhouette: Five to seven compact upright separated spikes above crown, tight short sides and nape, no swept crest and no trailing locks.
styles.asymmetry: Upright balanced crest; small strand asymmetry mirrored.

styles.name: มวยต่ำ
styles.silhouette: Smooth swept-back cap with one compact coiled bun centered low at the nape, short fixed crimson woven tie, no high knot or loose long tail.
styles.asymmetry: Centered bun; fixed crimson tie has no left/right emblem and is mirrored.

styles.name: มวยสูง
styles.silhouette: Swept-back compact scalp cap and one unmistakable small coiled HIGH topknot above rear crown, short fixed crimson woven tie, clean exposed nape. No feather, loose ponytail or low bun.
styles.asymmetry: Centered knot, unlettered tie; west shading mirrored.

styles.name: ผมยาวประบ่า
styles.silhouette: Open soft parted fringe, straight layered locks reaching exactly shoulder line, broad blunt-ended lower silhouette, no waist tail or hair tie.
styles.asymmetry: Balanced loose shoulder locks; lighting mirrored in west.

styles.name: ผมยาวมัดครึ่งหัว
styles.silhouette: Upper hair gathered into a small centered rear tie with crimson cord; lower half remains loose and reaches upper back, distinct split between gathered crown and free side lengths.
styles.asymmetry: Centered half tie with no emblem; west lighting mirrored.

styles.name: ผมยาวปล่อย
styles.silhouette: Fully loose long flowing hair with open center fringe, broad continuous gently tapered lengths down to waist level, visible long side/back lengths in all views. NO braid, bun, knot, bow, ribbon or feathers.
styles.asymmetry: Balanced loose lengths; tiny strand variations and light direction mirrored in west.

styles.name: ผมเปียเดี่ยว
styles.silhouette: Neat swept-back cap and one centered thick interwoven braid descending to mid-back, repeated readable alternating braid lobes, fixed crimson end tie, no twin side tails.
styles.asymmetry: Centered braid; weave handedness and lighting mirrored in west.

styles.name: ผมเปียคู่
styles.silhouette: Center-parted compact crown with TWO separated braids behind the ears reaching chest or mid-back level, alternating braid lobes, two fixed crimson end ties, never one merged tail.
styles.asymmetry: Balanced paired braids; profile may occlude far braid, recorded as mirror approximation.

styles.name: ทรงพลิ้วเสย
styles.silhouette: Loose broad swept-back windblown crest with several outward curved pointed locks, open forehead, irregular short-to-medium back locks, NO tied long tail, feathers or bow.
styles.asymmetry: Directional wind sweep requires an authored opposite profile; original tied-tail hairstyle is not this design.
